title: MADS: Multi-Agent Dialog Simulation for Robust Conversational Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.12757v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Task-oriented conversational agents remain fragile under realistic conditions, especially when users exhibit non-cooperative behavior. Existing function-calling benchmarks underrepresent adversarial conversation trajectories, thereby limiting the training resources available for developing robust agents. We present MADS (Multi-Agent Dialog Simulation), a synthetic data generation pipeline that produces structured, diverse dialogue trajectories. We inject adversarial conversation, producing validated conversation trajectories that capture realistic, unhappy paths. Using MADS, we construct MADS-Bench: a benchmark spanning six domains, 55 personas, and 1095 conversations, with approximately 66% of conversations containing failure-prone conversation scenarios. We evaluate the robustness of the trained models using a two-stage training approach that combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR

translated_title: MADS：面向鲁棒对话代理的多智能体对话模拟
translated_abstract: 面向任务的对话代理在现实条件下仍然脆弱，尤其是当用户表现出不合作行为时。现有的函数调用基准测试对对抗性对话轨迹的呈现不足，从而限制了开发鲁棒代理可用的训练资源。我们提出了MADS（多智能体对话模拟），这是一个合成数据生成管道，能够生成结构化、多样化的对话轨迹。我们注入对抗性对话，生成经过验证的对话轨迹，捕捉真实的、失败频发的路径。利用MADS，我们构建了MADS-Bench：一个涵盖六个领域、55个人设和1095段对话的基准，其中约66%的对话包含容易导致失败的对话场景。我们使用结合监督微调（SFT）和可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）的两阶段训练方法评估了训练模型的鲁棒性。
tldr: 提出了MADS多智能体对话模拟管道，通过注入对抗性对话生成多样化的失败场景对话轨迹，并构建包含六领域、55个人设和1095段对话的MADS-Bench基准，用于训练和评估更鲁棒的任务导向对话代理。
en_tdlr: We present MADS, a multi-agent dialog simulation pipeline that injects adversarial conversations to generate diverse failure-prone trajectories, and construct MADS-Bench spanning six domains, 55 personas, and 1095 conversations to train and evaluate robust task-oriented conversational agents.
